_about: The hero's own numbers and the numbers every place shares. Balancing is editing these files: numbers.json (the hero, the skills, loot and the chest's rules), monsters.json, places.json, items.json. Lengths are in world units (one unit is one design pixel at 412 by 915), times in seconds, speeds in units a second. All of them are Victor, GD's guesses (2026-11-20) unless a note says Robin; the ones Robin has felt and approved move to docs/lessons.md with his words.

spawn._about: A monster arrives somewhere in its zone on ground it can stand on, at least clearance from him, apart from the others, and never within landing of where he steps ashore, so a landing is safe.

hero._about: speed is the number 'smooth and snappy' hangs on: he crosses the screen's width in about two seconds. No acceleration: he is at full speed on the first step and stops on the step the thumb lifts. reach is the gap between the two bodies inside which a swing lands; reachGrace is how much further the target may have stepped back while the swing was in the air. In a town his health comes back at once and fast.

levels._about: Chapter 1 goes from level 1 to 5 (Robin, 2026-11-20). xpToNext[level] is what a level needs to become the next. Each level gives health and a little damage, and fills his health. The whole climb is meant to take about half an hour of hunting; the bot prints the real time.

autoTarget._about: When the player has not picked a target, the rules pick one. pickRange: how near a monster must be to be picked. dropRange: how far the target may get before it is let go. switchMargin: another monster must be this much nearer before he changes his mind, and never while the target is in reach.

charge._about: A dash to the target that stuns it and gives rage. holdSeconds roots the target for the moment of the dash so he does not chase a moving thing.

cleave._about: A wide swing in front of him that hits everything in the arc. It costs rage, so it is the reward for hitting. radius is measured from his middle to the monster's edge.

potion._about: A healing draught: bought in the harbour, sometimes dropped. It mends over a few seconds, so it is drunk before the bite, not after.

drops._about: Loot pops out of the monster (Robin, 2026-11-20: 'items should pop out of monsters when dropped'): each thing lands scatter from where it fell, and lies there for settleSeconds before it can fly to him, so he sees what fell even when he stands on it. Then it flies to him when he is close (Robin, 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-20). magnetRange is how close; a full bag leaves gear on the ground. What is left behind when he sails or falls is gone.

world._about: A place can be big: a monster further than awake from him that is only strolling does not move (it sleeps), so a step costs the same however big an island grows. About three and a half screens' height.

death._about: Robin, 2026-11-20: a share of the money he carries, 'say 10%', and he wakes in the harbour town. The number is his to feel.

reach._about: How near he must stand to open a chest, to sail from a dock, to trade with a shopkeeper. shopFront is how far before the stall's middle he stands to trade: the stall in the town on stilts has 38 units of deck before it and then the sea.
